text: {"252":{"about":["rustc_interface"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_interface owns DEFAULT_QUERY_PROVIDERS and invokes the registered provider sets during initialization."},"253":{"about":["rustc_query_impl","rustc_metadata"],"refers":[],"why":"Query dispatch selects external-query handling, which obtains dependency information through metadata loading."},"254":{"about":["rustc_metadata"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_metadata decodes .rmeta files and supplies the stored external-crate information."},"255":{"about":["rustc_query_impl"],"refers":["rustc_span"],"why":"The query implementation dispatches based on a DefId's local-versus-external crate identity; DefId itself is defined by rustc_span."},"256":{"about":["rustc_query_impl"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"The query dispatcher chooses between local and external provider tables, while rustc_middle defines those table types."}}
